_readme: DJ's word on where peoples moved, for Through time (scripts/build_years_commoners.py migration_layers). Each keyframe is a year and the land of one or more of DJ's 1765 countries (data/canon/country-shapes.json), speaking one language (its id in data/languages.json) or "as in 1765" (what DJ's last commoners map shows there, as its stage in that year). Each is taken as one of his regional keyframes: between two of them the yearly map switches by the usual rule, outwards from the language's speakers. "where" limits a keyframe to part of its land, the rest speaking what this file had there before: "stateless" (the land no state held on the rulers' map that year) "east" / "west" / "north" / "south" (the islands or land farthest that way, a tenth of it), {"near": a 1765 country, "km": distance} or {"near": country, "share": fraction} (the land that close to it), {"coast": km} (the land that close to the sea), and with any of them "instead of": a family or language (only the land DJ's last map gives it). {"ruled by": a state on DJ's rulers' maps, "year": y} (the land it held then). "speaks" can be a list of languages sharing the land. "homelands": {family name: 1765 country} sets where a family spread from (else the land of its first civilisation). Add, change or delete entries freely, then rebuild (python scripts/build-years.py languages). "spreads": {branch id: "with its states" | "as a people"} sets how a branch spread. "speaks" can also be {"neighbours": family or null, "km": n, "else": "lost"}: as the nearest people of that family (or of any other) on DJ's last map within km, past that a lost people. "not before": [{"family", "countries", "year"}]: no speech of that family there before that year.

_spreads_note: How a branch spread, where DJ's word overrides the measure from the rulers' maps (build_years_commoners.spread_modes): "with its states" (a long-lived state's core absorbing its neighbours, as Chinese did) or "as a people". Arten: DJ, 19 Oct 2026: Areoix Lie is not a Rome parallel but a mix, a state that more or less existed throughout, like China.
